stylePresets.minimal: Flat surfaces, 1px crisp borders, subtle radius (Linear/Vercel style)
stylePresets.enterprise: Compact density, sharp radii, high information clarity (Odoo/ERP style)
stylePresets.soft: Generous rounded corners, soft elevation, airy spacing (Stripe/Notion style)
stylePresets.glass: Translucent surfaces with subtle backdrop blur (AI/Modern style)

erp-finance.label: ERP / Internal Payment / Finance
erp-finance.notes: Use DetailLayout 2:1 for vouchers/records (main: form/line-items/comments; aside: status/attachments/watchers/audit-log).

saas-dashboard.label: SaaS Analytics & Operations Dashboard
saas-dashboard.notes: KPI cards can double as interactive queue filters; always pair charts with a clear period label.

ai-copilot.label: AI Agent / Copilot Workspace
ai-copilot.notes: Always surface ApprovalCard before destructive/external tool calls and ContextWindow for token budget.

admin-rbac.label: Admin, Roles & System Settings
admin-rbac.notes: Use PermissionMatrix for role×module RBAC and DataComparison for config/record diffs.

crm-sales.label: CRM / Pipeline & Project Tracking
crm-sales.notes: Support switching between KanbanBoard, ListLayout, and CalendarView.

auth-onboarding.label: Authentication & Onboarding
auth-onboarding.notes: Keep auth forms centered in AuthLayout with clear validation feedback.

chartRules.trend_over_time: Use Chart (bar/line) with explicit period labels

motionRules.duration: 150ms–200ms ease-out for sidebar, drawers, and AnimatedCollapse
motionRules.reducedMotion: Avoid continuous infinite animations on data-heavy views

uxChecklist: Never hardcode hex/rgb colors — use semantic Tailwind tokens only.
Use Page Layout Decision Tree: WorkspaceLayout / ListLayout / DetailLayout (ratio='2:1').
Limit KPI row to max 4 StatCards on desktop; collapse to 1 column on mobile.
Include EmptyState, LoadingSkeleton, and ErrorState for async data views.
Format all comment and audit timestamps as full DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm.

accessibility: Use semantic tokens (text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, bg-surface) to guarantee WCAG contrast in light & dark modes.
Always provide aria-label on icon-only buttons and visible focus-visible rings.
Support Escape to close Dialog/Drawer/Popover and Enter to submit forms.
formUx: Place inline validation errors directly below FormField; never rely on toast-only errors.
Disable submit button and show loading state (ActionButton / Spinner) during async requests.
Use CurrencyInput with font-mono tabular-nums for financial amounts.
tableUx: Right-align numeric and currency columns with tabular-nums.
Always handle loading (LoadingSkeleton), empty (EmptyState), and error (ErrorState) states.
Surface active filters as removable chips (DynamicFilter) with a Clear all action.
typographyHierarchy: Limit to 3 type scales per screen: Page Title (text-xl font-bold), Section Title (text-sm font-semibold), Body/Meta (text-xs).
Follow 4px spacing grid (gap-3, gap-4, p-4, space-y-6).
Display full DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm timestamps on comments and audit logs.
performance: Lazy-load heavy views (FlowCanvas, GanttChart, Studio) with React.lazy + Suspense.
Avoid continuous infinite animations on data-heavy tables or dashboards.
